'''Damien Inglis''' (born May 20, 1995) is a French professional [[basketball]] player who currently plays for [[Chorale Roanne Basket]] of the [[LNB Pro A]]. He is considered to be one of the top prospects in the [[2014 NBA draft|2014 NBA Draft]] by award-winning sports columnist [[Gary Parrish]].<ref>{{cite web|last1=Parrish|first1=Gary|title=NBA Draft Prospect Rankings: Overall|url=http://www.cbssports.com/nba/draft/prospect-rankings|website=CBSSports.com|accessdate=25 June 2014}}</ref> Inglis has also played for the [[France national basketball team|France under-18 national basketball team]] and the [[France national basketball team|France under-16 national basketball team]] on multiple occasions.<ref>{{cite web|title=Damien Inglis - U18 Profile|url=http://u18men.fibaeurope.com/en/cid_2bqXUaQOJwYn9c2ymJyFx0.teamID_282.compID_8aYeHlfuGF-mF5IqO8aFH1.season_2013.roundID_9420.playerID_85859.html|website=FIBAEurope.com|accessdate=25 June 2014}}</ref>
